config.orbitalstrike.title: Simple Orbital Strike Config
config.orbitalstrike.nukeRadius.tooltip: Max ring radius for nuke strike (blocks). Larger = bigger explosion. Default: 30
config.orbitalstrike.nukeRingStep.toolti: Gap between nuke rings (blocks). Smaller = more rings = more TNT. Default: 3
config.orbitalstrike.nukeFuse.tooltip: How long TNT burns before exploding. 20 ticks = 1 second. Default: 80
config.orbitalstrike.strikeDelay.tooltip: Delay in milliseconds before the strike arrives after firing. Default: 1000
config.orbitalstrike.permissionLevel.too: Operator level required to use /orbitalstrike. 0=everyone, 1=moderator, 2=gamemaster, 3=admin, 4=owner. Default: 2
